title: Lease Term Agreement Terms — Leaving Before the Term End Date
content:
A resident who must leave a Lease Term Agreement before its term end date has exactly three routes, decided in this order: a statutory release under the statutory release rule, the Early Termination Option, or a lease break.

## Article 1 — Request, quote and signature

1.1 Each is requested through an early termination request, quoted, and takes effect only when the resident signs it; signing is the resident's own act. Whether a route has taken effect is read from the request's type and status on its record.

1.2 A quote is valid for the program's quote validity days; an expired quote must be requoted.

## Article 2 — The Early Termination Option

2.1 **Months into the term.** The Early Termination Option may be exercised only when the current date is on or after the term start date plus the program's months-into-term figure for the option. Months into the term are counted in calendar months from the term start date to the same day number of a later month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day number does not exist.

| Hypothetical term start | Months required | First day the option may be exercised |
|---|---|---|
| 15 January | 6 | 15 July (14 July is too early) |
| 31 August | 6 | the last day of February (no 31 February exists) |
| 10 March | 3 | 10 June |

2.2 The option further requires that it is available on the program, a termination date at least the program's minimum notice days (calendar days) after the date the request was submitted, and, when the program requires it, no past-due balance on the lease.

2.3 Its early termination fee is the program's fee multiple times the contracted rent, rounded half up to the cent. The multiple is replaced by the job relocation multiple when the program has the job relocation clause and the resident documents a new workplace at least the program's minimum distance away, or by the home purchase multiple when the program has the home purchase clause and the resident documents a home purchase closing; when both are documented the lower multiple applies.

2.4 The fee is due within the program's payment days of signing, and rent continues to post under the Apartment Home Lease rules through the termination date.

*Worked example (hypothetical).* Contracted rent 2,000.00 dollars on the Standard Lease (10-12 Months) program (multiple 2.00, job relocation multiple 1.00, no home purchase clause): without a documented relocation the fee is 4,000.00 dollars; with a documented new workplace 60 miles away it is 2,000.00 dollars; with a new workplace 40 miles away the relocation multiple does not apply and the fee stays 4,000.00 dollars.

## Article 3 — Lease break

*Retired clause.* The clause "when the option is not available, the exit is a lease break: a reletting fee of the program's reletting fee rate times the contracted rent is assessed, and when the program carries lease-break rent liability lease-break rent accrues under the term charge rule from the day after move-out until the day before a replacement resident's lease starts on the apartment home or the term end date, whichever comes first" is **no longer in force**, together with the reletting fee it defined (the reletting fee rate times the contracted rent, rounded half up to the cent); it has been superseded by the current basis for a lease break.

## Article 4 — Concession recapture on an early exit

*Retired clause.* The clause "on either route, when the program recaptures concessions a concession recapture of the unearned concession is assessed; the job relocation and home purchase clauses do not waive it" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for concession recapture.

## Article 5 — One set of charges per request

Only one early termination fee, reletting fee and concession recapture is assessed per early termination request. The check reads the term charges already booked against that request.

## Article 6 — Month-to-month agreements

A month-to-month agreement is ended by notice alone and has no early termination.
